 AFP Ahmad Salah 26 Oct 2026 16:29-05:00 Translated by Ballon d'Or 2026: Barcelona's coach and young star open the women's awards
 Spain's Vicky López was crowned the world's best young player at the 2026 Ballon d'Or awards ceremony, organised by France Football magazine, at the London Palladium on Monday evening. 
 Lucy Bronze presented the award. The England star read out the five contenders: Verle Boorman, Vicky López, Felicia Schröder, Clara Serrajordi and Lily Yohannes. The name she announced was López, and the Barcelona player confirmed once again that the Catalan club's academy keeps churning out talent. 
 Ballon d'Or prize for best coach 2026
 Barcelona's night didn't end with López. Coach Pere Romeu claimed the award for the world's best coach after an exceptional campaign that carried the Barcelona women's team to fresh heights. 
 Spanish coach Rafa Benítez handed over the award, the man behind the famous Miracle of Istanbul, where he masterminded Liverpool's historic 3-3 comeback from three goals down before winning on penalties in the 2005 Champions League final. 
 Romeu is the true architect of Barcelona women's latest stunning season. It marked the Catalan club's third appearance on the podium, following López and Lamine Yamal, who scooped the best young player award.
